sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Relationships column: on release listings that have a Label column — an artist's releases, a release group's releases, a recording's releases and similar pages — every row was looked up as a LABEL (/ws/2/label/<release id>) instead of as a release, so the column showed no relationship icons at all. The row's own record-label link was mistaken for the entity the row stands for. Release rows are now always looked up as releases; work- and label-targeted sub-tables on relationship pages are still detected as before.
